Actually the schema says module_designation: "Analog load cell" | "Not applicable" | null. Since not stated, null.
- Description: The description text about vibrating tubes etc.

Model family: The cert covers two types: CDM100M (Stainless Steel) and CDM100P (Nickel alloy C22). These are two models. Attributes: Type/material varies by model. The rest of the characteristics appear to be the same for both. So model_family with models CDM100M and CDM100P, and model_level attribute "material" or "tube_material": CDM100M → Stainless Steel, CDM100P → Nickel alloy C22 (N06022).

Maybe add a separate characteristic "ambient_conditions": "condensing; open and closed locations". Or include in description. I could add attribute temperature_range_ambient_condition. The rule example: `110-240V AC 50/60Hz` → split into voltage, frequency, type. So here: power_supply_voltage: {value: 24, unit_symbol: "V"}, power_supply_type: {value: "DC"}. Also note "either from flow computer or external power supply" — could be a note. Maybe power_supply_source: "flow computer or external power supply".
